beats: A quiz wall and the family calendar told two different stories about the same day.
The wall just grabbed the next card, never checking what the kid actually had at school tomorrow.
Now it walks tomorrow's real timetable, child by child, subject by subject, in the class's own order.
A glowing ring lights the matching day, so the calendar and the wall finally agree.
A small Cloudflare Workers job now catches up two drifted schedules a night instead of one.
